title: Mostly good albums, Poor Functionality
text:
I've had this membership for almost a year now, and I've gotten some really good albums for less than buying them individually, so that's great. It's fun to see what album they're sending... they've almost all been good so far.

Unfortunately, there's a big problem with the functionality of this membership. I signed up on the 18th of the month, so I have to look at my orders on the 18th of every month to see what's going to ship, in case I want to skip it. This month, nothing showed up. On the 19th, Dark Side of the Moon appeared in my order list... which is an awesome record, but I already own it, so I opted to skip it. Despite the fact that it hadn't shipped, Amazon said it was too late, and they shipped it to me the next day anyway. Now I have to keep the duplicate or deal with a return. Annoying. They really should have a period of several days, not several hours, for users to choose whether they want something shipped. This has happened to me a couple of times, now.

And in general, it would be really helpful if Amazon had a place to list preferences (bands, styles, albums, etc), or at the very least list the albums that we already own so that we don't get duplicates. I'd be really annoyed if I had to pay $25 for a Fleetwood Mac album that I could get for $3 on the used market.
label: neutral
